name: Geometry-adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (Geo-FNO)
summary: Adapt FNO-type spectral computation to irregular physical domains by learning a coordinate deformation.
core_idea: Map an irregular physical geometry into a latent regular domain where Fourier operator layers are applied.
innovation: Retains spectral efficiency while accommodating nonrectangular geometries and heterogeneous meshes.
limitations: Performance depends on the learned deformation quality.
Strong changes in geometry may challenge generalization.

start_here.why: Key extension of FNO for nonuniform geometries.
start_here.focus: Learned deformation, FFT in latent space, and general-geometry tests.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
